scripts.synth: pnpm run build:dependencies && pnpm run build && cdk synth
scripts.diff: pnpm run build:dependencies && pnpm run build && cdk diff
scripts.deploy:cdk: pnpm run build:dependencies && pnpm run build && cdk deploy --require-approval never
scripts.deploy: pnpm run deploy:cdk && pnpm run sync:edge-auth
scripts.destroy: pnpm run build:dependencies && pnpm run build && cdk destroy --force
scripts.bootstrap: pnpm run build:dependencies && pnpm run build && cdk bootstrap
